changelog: **Subagent List** (`tc-subagent-list`): the sub-agents a session has started, grouped Active (running or waiting) and Done (finished, failed or stopped) with counts. Each row is the agent's own mark – a flower, star, rings or leaves in one of six tones, drawn from its id – its name, what it's doing now, and a time: a clock that ticks while it's active ("1m 26s") or how long ago it ended ("just now", "1h ago"). Waiting, failed and stopped say so in words; rows are one tab stop with the arrow keys; choosing one fires a cancelable `tc-selected-change`; agents that finish, fail or start waiting are announced. Also exported: `subagentMark()` and `subagentClock()`.

features.name: light-dark()

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets

features.name: forced-colors media query
